Ipilimumab-induced dermatomyositis: F21: Laboratory test: Jo-1 antibody negative
F23: Biopsy result: vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis
F24: Biopsy timing: performed after corticosteroid treatment
F6: Time to skin symptoms: within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab
F7: Physical finding: photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
F8: Physical finding: diffuse erythema of forehead and midface, involving nasolabial folds
F9: Physical finding: erythema and edema of upper eyelids
F10: Physical finding: diffuse erythema of upper chest and upper back
F11: Physical finding: flagellate erythema on posterior neck
F12: Physical finding: flat-topped pink to erythematous papules over knuckles
F13: Physical finding: prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
F14: Muscle strength: Grade 4/5 on resisted abduction of shoulders bilaterally
F15: Limited flexion of both hips
F16: Reduced activity level due to weakness and early fatigue
F17: Laboratory test: Creatine kinase 1088 U/L (increased to 1854 U/L)
F20: Laboratory test: Antinuclear antibody titer 1:640 with speckled pattern
